description: This file defines the FileSystemMonitor class and related internal classes for monitoring file system changes across different platforms (Apple, Linux, Windows). It includes mechanisms for registering callbacks, handling platform-specific file system events, and notifying observers of changes.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor
classes.description: Main class for monitoring file system changes across platforms, managing observers and platform-specific event handling.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback objects that are notified when a file system change occurs.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::Observer
classes.description: Internal class managing a list of callbacks for a specific file or directory.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::Context
classes.description: Platform-specific internal class for handling file system change notifications on Windows.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::Dispatcher
classes.description: Thread class responsible for processing file system events asynchronously on Windows.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the FileSystemMonitor.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the monitor is properly initialized and valid.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a callback for a specific file or directory to be notified of changes.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a callback from a specific file or directory.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes pending file system events (Windows only).

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers the event to wake the processing thread (Windows only).
